## What happened

The writer at `scripts/post-merge-hook.sh:336` rewrote every occurrence of the marker
token anywhere in the body. Any prose mention of STATUS:DONE was unsafe to write until
this shipped — a stray STATUS:DONE in an example turned into a second live marker, and
STATUS:DONE showing up a third time in a caption made a third. By the time a fourth
STATUS:DONE appeared in the closing paragraph, the body had four prose mentions with
nothing anchoring them to a specific line.

## Reproduction

```
STATUS:PENDING
STATUS:BLOCKED
```

Everything below the line-1 marker is prose or a fenced example; none of it should change
when the marker is rewritten.
